headline: Russia claims 328 Ukrainian drones downed, Ukraine faces looming bankruptcy
subheadline: Russian Ministry of Defense claims 328 Ukrainian UAVs destroyed overnight, with debris striking an Ozon warehouse in Orenburg and causing damage
lede: Israeli forces eliminated Hamas commander Ismail Abu Pola in Gaza, while Iran’s currency plunged to 199,400 tomans. In the Ukraine-Russia war, Russia claimed 328 Ukrainian UAVs were destroyed overnight, with debris hitting an Ozon warehouse in Orenburg. Ukraine’s budget crisis deepens as lawmakers warn of potential bankruptcy if 27 critical laws are not passed by October. Iranian state media announced a massive 5.7 trillion cubic feet gas field discovery in Fars province.

sections.title: Russian UAV offensive shatters Ukrainian air defenses
sections.body: Russian MoD reported 328 Ukrainian UAVs destroyed overnight, with debris striking an Ozon warehouse in Orenburg. Ukrainian air monitoring confirmed Russian jet UAVs operating across Dnipropetrovsk, Kharkiv, Sumy, Chernihiv, Odesa, Kherson, Mykolaiv, and Kirovohrad oblasts. MP Poturaiev warned that failure to pass 27 pending laws by October could trigger bankruptcy due to insufficient funds for military salaries. Zelensky noted the ‘corridor of opportunity’ to end the war extends until summer 2027 before the US election cycle begins.

sections.title: Israel eliminates Hamas commander, Iran currency collapses
sections.body: Israeli forces killed Hamas commander Ismail Abu Pola in Gaza, citing his role in weapon production. Iran’s currency (USD/IRR) reached 199,400 tomans, approaching the 2‑million mark. Iranian state media announced a 5.7 trillion cubic feet gas field discovery in Fars province. Iran’s Foreign Ministry condemned French diplomats’ ‘unacceptable interference’ in regional affairs.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Iran’s deepening currency crisis alongside a major gas field discovery and diplomatic rebukes reflects a regime balancing internal economic strain with regional assertiveness. Meanwhile, Ukraine’s intensified UAV losses and looming budget bankruptcy underscore a war entering a critical phase where military operations and fiscal sustainability are increasingly intertwined.
